messages:
tess_support: P1 escalation -> HarborBridge trial failing during onboarding. New API keys return 403 on provisioning and embeds. Ticket SUP-161000 opened. Usage ramping, renewal in ~5w. Looping CS for handoff and comms.

ops-bot: Alert: 8 provisioning failures for tenant harborbridge-test in last 10h. Pattern: 403 auth_failure. https://redwood.inc/alerts/SUP-161000

marc_cs: Thanks Tess. I'll own customer comms. Can eng confirm whether this is a platform regression or tenant config? Need impacted endpoints, last successful request, and ETA for mitigation so I can draft a note.

tess_support: Sanitized repro:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inc/v1/tenants/harborbridge-test/embeds" -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_***' -d '{"input":"probe"}'
# response: {"status":403,"error":"auth_failure","request_id":"req_ab12"}
```
SE tried manual rotate; customer reports rotation job still gets 403.

nathan_eng: We merged a verifier tweak yesterday that touched short-lived tokens. Rolling the change back to confirm. If rollback stops the errors we'll cut a hotfix. ETA ~25m.

ida_se: I can run a targeted cache invalidate for harborbridge-test and prepare a secure upload link for an ephemeral token. Marc, can you ask the customer for a 30-min troubleshooting window tomorrow 10:30am PT and to pause automated rotation during that time?

ryan_ae: I'll join the call and notify the AE. Renewal flag: high. Please prepare a brief, non-technical customer note and a one-paragraph sales update.

marc_cs: Draft customer note suggestion:
"Hi HarborBridge team 0mdash; we9re investigating intermittent provisioning failures affecting API key validation. We9ve scheduled a troubleshooting session for tomorrow at 10:30am PT. As a temporary step please pause automatic key rotation and, if possible, upload a short-lived token via our secure form so our engineers can run a live test. We9ll follow up within 24 hours with a remediation plan. For urgent help contact ops@redwood.com"

tess_support: Looks good. Add SUP-161000 link and list impacted endpoints: POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/provision and POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/embeds. Marking ticket P1.

nathan_eng: Rollback in progress, watching metrics. If errors drop to zero we'll update the ticket with RCA and timeline.

ida_se: Secure upload link prepped; will send when Marc confirms the window. I'll run the live repro during the session and report back.

ops-bot: Incident record created: INCIDENT-20260401-03. Runbook: onboarding-provisioning. Escalation level: CS-P1.

marc_cs: Owners: Tess = support contact & ticket updates, Ida = SE repro lead, Nathan = eng owner, Ryan = AE notification. I'll update SUP-161000 with the comms draft and confirm calendar invite. Will post final customer note once rollback verified. :white_check_mark:
